name: Russia
note: Inventions with a recorded country of origin in Wikidata, topped up from the English Wikipedia's per-country invention list articles (CC BY-SA). Every entry passed a Wikidata class check (device, technology, process, product, software, medication ...); diseases, species, discoveries, theorems and food are excluded by ruling. Dates are recorded or parsed from prose and are often approximate.

inventions.name: 2S42 Lotos
inventions.description: 2S42 "Lotos" (Russian: 2С42 «Лотос»; "Lotos") is a developing Russian self-propelled 120 mm mortar system meant for the Russian Airborne Forces.

inventions.name: Airliner
inventions.description: An airliner is a type of airplane for transporting passengers and air cargo.

inventions.name: Axe
inventions.description: An axe is an implement that has been used for thousands of years to shape, split, and cut wood, to harvest timber, and as a weapon.

inventions.name: Military uniform
inventions.description: A military uniform is a standardised form of dress worn by members of an armed force or paramilitary unit to identify their service, rank, role and affiliation.

inventions.name: Clay
inventions.description: Clay is a type of fine-grained natural soil material containing clay minerals.

inventions.name: Samovar
inventions.description: A samovar is a metal container traditionally used to heat and boil water.

inventions.name: Rushnyk
inventions.description: A rushnyk or rushnik is a decorative and ritual cloth.

inventions.name: Vandal (tanker)
inventions.description: Vandal was a river tanker designed by Karl Hagelin and Johny Johnson for Branobel.

inventions.name: Synthetic rubber
inventions.description: A synthetic rubber is an artificial elastomer.

inventions.name: Sikorsky Ilya Muromets
inventions.description: The Sikorsky Ilya Muromets was a class of Russian pre-World War I large four-engine commercial airliners and military heavy bombers used during World War I by the Russian Empire.

inventions.name: Troika (driving)
inventions.description: A troika is a high-speed Russian harness driving combination, using three horses abreast.
